'''Joe Shnaudt''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Columbus tournament]] on 10 February 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]], according to David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1729">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-columbus-ohio-2-10-01d1729/ columbus-ohio-2-10-01], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 13 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-columbus-ohio-2-10-01d1729/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
